description: Get the current Danish electricity price (this hour) for a price zone. Use for "hvad er elprisen lige nu / hvad koster strøm nu".

area.description: Danish price zone: DK1 = Vestdanmark (Jylland og Fyn), DK2 = Østdanmark (Sjælland, Lolland-Falster, Bornholm).

mode.description: Price view: spot_ex = raw spot price (no VAT); spot_inkl = spot incl. 25% VAT; inkl_alt = total price incl. system/transmission tariffs + electricity tax + VAT (what you actually pay); inkl_alt_minus = total without electricity tax.

name: get_current_price
